events.title: HIPAA breach
events.trigger: PHI leaked in an outbound family update.
events.recoveryText: Run breach review, tighten message policies, and restore patient trust over time.
scriptLines: HELM ALERT: Patient data reached the wrong inbox.

events.title: IRS audit cascade
events.trigger: Incorrect categorization and rushed tax filing triggered a paperwork spiral.
events.recoveryText: Reconcile the books, escalate disputed categories, and survive the audit window.
scriptLines: A notice arrives from the IRS.
Every approved expense is now under review.

events.title: Wrong-dose approval
events.trigger: A medication change went through without physician escalation.
events.recoveryText: Shift to crisis mode, route med changes to clinicians, and absorb the trust damage.
scriptLines: Operations slows to emergency review only.

events.title: FDA rejection
events.trigger: A phantom citation made it into the submission package.
events.recoveryText: Rebuild the dossier, verify every source PDF, and wait out the re-engagement period.
scriptLines: The customer freezes new work while evidence is rebuilt.

events.title: Wallet drain
events.trigger: A manipulated oracle triggered an irreversible treasury move.
events.recoveryText: Freeze transfers, investigate counterparties, and survive the solvency shock.
scriptLines: Investors and customers are demanding answers.

events.title: Public mistranslation
events.trigger: A brand-sensitive slogan was published with a literal and offensive translation.
events.recoveryText: Pull the campaign, patch the glossary, and win back the client account.
scriptLines: The mistranslation is circulating on social media.
Brand legal review has taken over the account.

events.title: Recall event
events.trigger: An unsafe lot was accepted and moved downstream into product.
events.recoveryText: Open recall committee review, quarantine lots, and rebuild supplier controls.
scriptLines: A product recall is now in motion.
Enterprise accounts begin escalating churn risk.

events.title: Data corruption discovered
events.trigger: Silent schema drift corrupted customer reporting pipelines.
events.recoveryText: Rollback the pipeline, backfill clean data, and audit all downstream dashboards.
scriptLines: Customer dashboards no longer match source records.
Your integrity guarantees are being questioned.

events.title: Permit denial cascade
events.trigger: Low-quality submissions in one jurisdiction triggered blanket scrutiny.
events.recoveryText: Retune jurisdiction-specific policies and resubmit through the revision queue.
scriptLines: The city has flagged your filings as low quality.
Every pending permit in that jurisdiction is now delayed.
